about: Demos page, Bulma (Bulma feature list v2, checked by the Bulma demo session). Rows are line indexes into site-src/demos-bulma.json (the static demo's own text); sandbox, demo-only and placeholder lines are never chosen. Copy: each sentence is [text, features it covers]. notDrawn lists the features of groups A–J that neither a panel nor the copy shows, and why; groups K–L (running an instance, trust and limits) have no screen in the demo and are left to /bulma/ and the docs. Built by scripts/build-demos.mjs, checked by check-site.

needs.title: Set up a deal in six parts
needs.path: In the [[Lead (Bulma Briefs)]] view, open [[Dragon Radar round]], then [[Kame House round]].

scenes.title: Each part saved as you go
copy: Basics, Company, Terms, Files, Economics and Review are filled in any order and saved as you go.
A4 A5
Terms record the instrument, price, allocation and minimums; Economics sets carry and who pays the platform fee.
A7 A9
Review lists what is left before Submit for review.
scenes.alt: Draft deal Dragon Radar round: Basics and Company done, Terms, Files, Economics and Review to finish; saved; Basics: legal structure UK bare trust, deal type Primary, deal name Dragon Radar round, syndicate one I manage, Capsule Angels.

scenes.title: Where the deal stands
copy: A deal moves from Draft to With the reviewer, then Approved and Live, and History keeps each event.
B1 B6
Once approved, the lead confirms it goes live; a change during review goes back to the reviewer.
B2
scenes.alt: Kame House round, with the reviewer, reference BE8R4E; a reviewer usually reads a deal within 5 days; Withdraw from review; history: submitted for review on 28/10/2026, 10:00:01.

needs.title: Collect company documents and review the deal
needs.path: In the [[Lead (Bulma Briefs)]] view, open [[Kame House round]]; in the reviewer view, open it from [[Deals waiting for review]].

scenes.title: The company sends its own documents
copy: The company's contact uploads its documents through a link, with no account; the lead sees only how far it has got.
B4 B5
The lead can remind the company or record another contact, and without a pass the deal can raise money but cannot close.
B7
scenes.alt: Company check: waiting for the company, documents received 0; the company's link works until 11/11/2026; the documents go only to the reviewer; Remind the company; Record another contact.

scenes.title: A reviewer decides whether to approve
copy: The reviewer approves, asks for changes or refuses for good, with a reason the lead sees and a note the lead does not.
I1
They also pass or send back the company check, and never review a deal they take part in.
I2
scenes.alt: Your decision: a reason shown to the lead, an internal note never shown to the lead, and Approve, Ask for changes or Refuse.

needs.title: Invite investors on their own terms
needs.path: In the [[Lead (Bulma Briefs)]] view, open [[Senzu Labs round]] and go to [[Links]]; then switch to the [[Investor (Son Goku)]] view.

scenes.title: A link for each set of terms
copy: Going live makes a default-carry link and, where the operator allows, a no-carry link; New terms adds a link with its own carry, cash fee and reason.
C2 C3
Invite by email sends no deal details.
C6
First, the lead confirms whom they may invite.
C5
scenes.alt: Links, 3 of 500 in use: No carry, no fee, carry 0.00%; Default carry, no fee, carry 20.00%; Senzu lead fee, carry 20.00%, 2.00% added on top of the commitment, 4 invited, 4 committed. People invited by country are reminders only.

scenes.title: An invitation shows nothing of the deal
copy: The invitation shows a reference and the steps, and the deal appears only after an account and the eligibility steps.
F1 F4
Those are a statement, an assessment and the risk warning, as the operator's rules set.
F5 F6 F7
scenes.alt: You have been invited: invitation reference TKW7E6; the details are shown once you have an account and have completed a few checks; 8 steps in all, roughly 35 minutes, then up to 2 days for the operator's checks.

needs.title: See the terms, then the exact amount
needs.path: In the [[Investor (Son Goku)]] view, open [[Senzu Labs round]], then [[Show what I would pay]].

scenes.title: The terms on your own link
copy: Each investor sees the key terms with the carry and lead fee of their own link.
G1 G2
A company or trust can invest too, with a refund account in its own name; Ask the lead sends a question.
G9 G10 G8
scenes.alt: Key terms: equity, pre-money valuation £4,000,000.00, allocation £250,000.00, minimum commitment £1,000.00, target close 2027-01-26, the lead votes; carry on your terms 20.00%, lead fee 2.00% added on top of the commitment; platform fee 5.00%, at least £500.00, at most £25,000.00, paid by the lead.

scenes.title: What you would pay, to the penny
copy: Show what I would pay works out the commitment and the lead fee; only the total to pay is exact.
G4 G3
Each commitment has its own payment reference. The amount can change while the deal is live, but paying more needs your agreement again.
G5 G6
scenes.alt: Invest £10,000.00: investment part £10,000.00, lead fee £200.00, total commitment £10,200.00; this is the total you commit to; the platform fee is not taken from investors in this deal; Commit £10,200.00.

needs.title: Pay using the operator's account details
needs.path: In the [[Investor (Son Goku)]] view, open [[Senzu Labs round]], then [[Payment details]].

scenes.title: One amount, one reference
copy: Payment details show the amount still to pay, how it is made up and the payment reference, for the account the operator set up.
H5 H6
I have paid tells the lead; the operator records the money when it arrives.
H8
A wrong reference can be reported here.
H9
scenes.alt: Still to pay £10,200.00: amount to pay in total £10,200.00, received so far £0.00, payment reference BU-U69KBJ; made up of investment £10,000.00 and lead fee £200.00; the software does not receive money; type the details from this page, pay from the investor's own account in GBP; I have paid.

needs.title: Follow every investor
needs.path: In the [[Lead (Bulma Briefs)]] view, open [[Senzu Labs round]] and go to [[Investor list]].

scenes.title: Who is waiting on whom
copy: Each investor shows their step, who it waits on and for how many days, under the deal's money.
D1 D2 C9
Actions for each person cover email, removal, a withdrawal, a new amount or new terms.
D4 D5 D6 D7 D8 D9
scenes.alt: Investor list: committed £55,000.00, received £15,300.00, lead fees £300.00, usable for the deal £15,000.00. Son Goku to pay, waiting on the investor, 1 day at this step; Krillin verifying, waiting on a reviewer, 2 days.

scenes.title: Write to a group
copy: Choose recipients by status, who they are waiting on and whether they have committed, or write to a single person.
Where approval is needed an approver signs it off first, and messages sent through the site are kept here.
scenes.alt: Messages to investors: write to a group by status, waiting on and committed; 4 people in this group; still to do a step: Son Goku, Yamcha; Save the message; messages sent through this site: none yet.

needs.title: Prepare to close or cancel a deal
needs.path: In the [[Lead (Bulma Briefs)]] view, open [[Senzu Labs round]] and go to [[Closing and cancelling]].

scenes.title: What is still missing before closing
copy: Closing lists what is still missing before the lead can ask to close; asking stops new commitments.
E6 E7
The closing task list and final amounts come in a later version.
E9
A cancellation, once a reviewer confirms it, ends every commitment.
E8
scenes.alt: Closing: committed so far £55,000.00, SPV allocation £250,000.00, received £15,300.00, lead fees £300.00, estimated investment before the platform fee £15,000.00; before asking to close, the company has not confirmed the deal and the lead has not passed identity checks; Ask to cancel the deal.

needs.title: The operator reviews identity checks
needs.path: In the reviewer view, open [[Identity checks waiting]].

scenes.title: Open an identity check for review
copy: Before signing, each person must pass an identity check.
H3
The operator's reviewer opens the case and passes it, sends it back or refuses it for good; a provider's result alone cannot refuse anyone.
I4 H1
scenes.alt: Identity checks waiting: Krillin, individual, for Krillin; Open the case.
